dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: Following the instructions in the manual really did make the flowers bloom very well.

dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: Yes, it's a nursing manual on ornamental plants the Lord gave me. I heard it was personally revised by a Forest Watcher.

dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: Following the instructions in the manual guarantees that beautiful flowers bloom all year round here.

dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: Thanks, I'll take it as a compliment on the good job I did for the garden.

dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: Cutting a fresh flower with its leaves on, put it into a vase with water, and you'll make a very nice interior decoration.

dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: These are for you. Beautiful flowers will bring you good luck.
